brief: Answers yes/no questions about a text: palindrome, anagram, number form, case, composition, marks and regex match.
detail: It is the question-answering helper behind many Is... methods of stzString, which builds one over itself and passes the call on; reach for it directly when you only want the checks and not the whole string API. A question answers 1 or 0 and never changes the text. Every question counts characters, not bytes, so a Hebrew or Arabic word and an emoji are one character each. The number checks that expect a prefix (0b, 0o, 0x, U+) answer 0 without it. The case-flag forms (CS) take 1 to compare with case and 0 to ignore it. HasLeadingChars, HasTrailingChars and HasLeadingAndTrailingChars answer 0 for every text today; use the stzString methods of the same names.
